messages:
sara_finance: FYI invoice INV-2026-0587 from MapleLabs (Canada) flagged for missing withholding docs. Vendor says we must gross-up or they will withhold 15%. Asking tax: do we gross-up or hold? :warning:

ryan_procurement: vendor message copied here: "We are non-resident for Canadian tax and will deduct 15% withholding unless Redwood agrees to gross-up the invoice amount to cover tax. Please confirm by EOD/Friday to avoid delay."

sara_finance: Invoice excerpt pasted:```
INV-2026-0587
Vendor: MapleLabs Inc. (CA)
Amount: CAD 12,500.00
VAT: 0.00
Withholding: vendor requests gross-up for 15%
Docs: no W-8BEN-E on file, no Canadian TRC provided
```

nina_tax: Short answer: do NOT gross-up by default. Global policy requires tax docs before paying nonresident suppliers. We need a completed W-8BEN-E (if US entity) or Canadian TRC / treaty claim for reduced withholding, depending on their tax residency and structure. Gross-up only if there's an explicit contractual gross-up clause approved by legal and finance.

marc_ops: Vendor claims they already sent a W-8 to our portal last month. I searched vendor profile and can't find any attached docs. Procurement, can you re-check onboarding packet?

ryan_procurement: checked Coupa and onboarding checklist shows "tax docs: pending". I messaged vendor procurement contact to re-upload. Also asked for a scanned TRC if they're claiming treaty relief.

nina_tax: Next steps I recommend: 1) hold payment and mark invoice with code TAX_DOC_PENDING, 2) request signed W-8 or TRC and proof of Canadian tax residency (or treaty docs), 3) if they insist on gross-up, ask for contract clause and route to legal. If they self-withhold, require them to provide proof of payment/filing so we can reclaim where applicable.

sara_finance: Will set hold. paybot, apply hold code TAX_DOC_PENDING to INV-2026-0587 and prevent payout in this cycle.

paybot: action:hold_applied INV-2026-0587 reason=TAX_DOC_PENDING by=sara_finance at=1979012399

marc_ops: Vendor just replied: "We can provide TRC and will not deduct if Redwood gross-ups." I asked them to send docs to finance@redwood-inference.com and copied procurement.

nina_tax: If they send TRC that supports a 0% withholding we can release, but we still need to validate authenticity (tax authority stamp or verified portal). If they send only a unilateral statement, still hold.

ryan_procurement: I've opened ticket PR-4621 and assigned to vendor onboarding. ETA for vendor doc re-upload: 48 hours.

sara_finance: Thanks. I'll keep invoice on hold and circle back once tax confirms doc validity. Noting escalation path to legal if vendor insists on gross-up. :memo:
